definitions.equity: Sum of each bot's latest valuation. Before its first run a bot holds exactly its starting capital.
definitions.contributed_capital: Sum of starting capital of deployed bots. Deployments are capital flows, not profit.
definitions.net_pnl: Equity minus contributed capital (= realized + unrealized).
definitions.realized_pnl: Net P&L of closed trades after commission; slippage is inside the fill prices.
definitions.unrealized_pnl: Open positions marked at the last bar close, after exit slippage and round-trip commission (liquidation basis).
definitions.twr: Time-weighted return: chain-linked across valuations with deployment flows removed.
definitions.max_drawdown: Largest peak-to-trough decline of the time-weighted index (running peak).
definitions.pnl_24h: Change in net P&L over the last 24 hours (deployments excluded).
definitions.gross_exposure: Open position notional at entry divided by fleet equity.
definitions.win_rate: Closed trades with net P&L > 0 divided by all closed trades (TP, SL, expiry and manual exits).
definitions.error: A bot is in error when its most recent analysis failed.
definitions.valuation_stale: Open positions whose last valuation is older than the freshness limit, or that belong to a paused bot (paused bots are not marked to market).
definitions.ops_stale: An active bot whose last analysis is older than the freshness limit.
definitions.daily_pnl: Change in fleet net P&L per UTC day. Days without any valuation have no value.

currency.note: Inferred from ticker format; amounts in different currencies are never summed.

limitations: Quote currency is inferred from the ticker format; it is not recorded when a bot is deployed.
Pause and resume times are not recorded, so paused periods cannot be drawn historically.
